notes: One topic per option, using Pearson's option codes: 10-13 (Paper 1 thematic studies), B1-B4 (Paper 2 British depth studies), P1-P5 (Paper 2 period studies) and 30-33 (Paper 3 modern depth studies). Subtopics are the key topics (for the thematic studies, the four periods in the order printed, c1000-c1500 = .1 and so on), and each point is one of the numbered items printed in the left column of the content tables, covering the bullets beside it: 31.2.3 = option 31, key topic 2, item 3. Each Paper 1 historic environment (Whitechapel; the British sector of the Western Front; London and the Second World War; Notting Hill) is fixed in the specification and is included in its thematic option's topic as the subtopic <option>.HE, whose items are numbered 1 and 2 as printed (10.HE.2 = knowledge, selection and use of sources). History is untiered: no Higher-only content. Skipped: the 'process of change' statements that introduce each thematic study (they describe the approach, not content), the Paper 2 pairings, and assessment information.
